filed.label: Filed
filed.definition: The proposal has been lodged with the authority that will decide it and has not yet been taken up.

verification.label: In verification
verification.definition: The authority's secretariat is checking the proposal for completeness and eligibility before appraisal.

administrative.label: Administrative steps
administrative.definition: The proposal is going through procedural steps, such as fee demands and payments or comments from the pollution control board, before appraisal continues.

query.label: Under query
query.definition: The authority has asked the applicant in writing for essential or additional details, and the proposal waits on the reply.

appraisal.label: In appraisal
appraisal.definition: The proposal is before an expert appraisal committee, or before the authority that decides on the committee's recommendation.

decided.label: Decided
decided.definition: The authority has issued a decision on the application, granting or refusing either the environmental clearance or the Terms of Reference that come before it. A grant of Terms of Reference settles only the scope of the impact assessment, and the clearance itself is still to be decided.

closed.label: Closed without decision
closed.definition: The proposal left the process without a decision on its merits, for example when the applicant withdrew it or the authority returned it. A proposal the portal delisted automatically can later be restored.

other.label: Other
other.definition: The proposal is at a recorded position outside the usual sequence from filing to decision, such as a transfer between authorities.

ec_granted.label: Environmental clearance granted
ec_granted.definition: The project has been granted environmental clearance, which it needs before construction or operation can begin.

ec_rejected.label: Environmental clearance refused
ec_rejected.definition: The application for environmental clearance, which the project needs before work can begin, was refused.

tor_granted.label: Terms of Reference granted
tor_granted.definition: Terms of Reference for the environmental impact assessment have been framed and issued for this project.

standard_tor_granted.label: Standard Terms of Reference granted
standard_tor_granted.definition: Terms of Reference have been issued from the published standard set for the project's category, without project-specific framing.

tor_rejected.label: Terms of Reference refused
tor_rejected.definition: The application for Terms of Reference was refused.

granted.label: Granted
granted.definition: The register records the application as granted but does not say whether the grant was of environmental clearance or of Terms of Reference.

form9_approved.label: Form 9 approved
form9_approved.definition: An application made on Form 9 was approved.

form9_rejected.label: Form 9 refused
form9_rejected.definition: An application made on Form 9 was refused.

form9_accepted.label: Form 9 accepted
form9_accepted.definition: An application made on Form 9 was accepted for processing.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.definition: The proposal has been lodged with the authority and awaits its first action.

draft.label: Draft
draft.definition: The applicant has begun the application but not yet submitted it.

intimated.label: Intimated
intimated.definition: The applicant has notified the authority of the proposal.

ms_verification.label: With the member secretary
ms_verification.definition: The member secretary, the official who runs the appraisal body's secretariat, is verifying the application.

under_verification.label: Under verification
under_verification.definition: The authority is checking the application for completeness and eligibility before appraisal.

under_verification_sceia.label: Under verification with SCEIA
under_verification_sceia.definition: The application is being verified by the Standing Committee on Environment Impact Appraisal (SCEIA), which appraises proposals while a State Expert Appraisal Committee is not functioning.

under_examination.label: Under examination
under_examination.definition: The authority is examining the application.

under_examination_sceia.label: Under examination with SCEIA
under_examination_sceia.definition: The application is being examined by the Standing Committee on Environment Impact Appraisal (SCEIA), which appraises proposals while a State Expert Appraisal Committee is not functioning.

under_processing.label: Under processing with the authority
under_processing.definition: The authority is processing the application, and the register records no more precise position.

pending_ms_seiaa.label: Pending with the member secretary, SEIAA
pending_ms_seiaa.definition: Awaiting action by the member secretary of the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority.

pending_ms_saeia.label: Pending with the member secretary, SAEIA
pending_ms_saeia.definition: Awaiting action by the member secretary of the Standing Authority on Environment Impact Assessment (SAEIA), which acts in place of a State Environment Impact Assessment Authority that is not functioning. The stage appears on 18 proposals, all from West Bengal.

eds_raised.label: Essential details sought
eds_raised.definition: The authority has asked the applicant in writing for essential details, and the proposal waits on the reply.
raw: eds raised by ms to ua

eds_replied.label: Essential details supplied
eds_replied.definition: The applicant has answered the authority's request for essential details.

eds_under_examination.label: Essential details under examination
eds_under_examination.definition: The authority is examining the applicant's reply to its request for essential details.

ads_raised.label: Additional details sought
ads_raised.definition: The authority has asked the applicant in writing for additional details, and the proposal waits on the reply.

referred_to_eac.label: Referred to the Expert Appraisal Committee
referred_to_eac.definition: Sent to the central Expert Appraisal Committee for appraisal.

referred_to_seac.label: Referred to the State Expert Appraisal Committee
referred_to_seac.definition: Sent to the State Expert Appraisal Committee for appraisal.

referred_to_seiaa.label: Referred to SEIAA
referred_to_seiaa.definition: Sent to the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority, which decides on the committee's recommendation.

referred_to_saeia.label: Referred to SAEIA
referred_to_saeia.definition: Sent to the Standing Authority on Environment Impact Assessment (SAEIA), which decides proposals while a State Environment Impact Assessment Authority is not functioning. It was first seen in the register read of 24 September 2026, on 131 proposals, all from Andhra Pradesh.

accepted_referred_to_eac.label: Accepted and referred to the Expert Appraisal Committee
accepted_referred_to_eac.definition: Accepted by the authority and sent to the central Expert Appraisal Committee.
raw: proposal accepted and referred to eac

accepted_referred_to_seac.label: Accepted and referred to the State Expert Appraisal Committee
accepted_referred_to_seac.definition: Accepted by the authority and sent to the State Expert Appraisal Committee.
raw: proposal accepted and referred to seac

accepted_referred_to_sceia.label: Accepted and referred to SCEIA
accepted_referred_to_sceia.definition: The authority has accepted the application and sent it to the Standing Committee on Environment Impact Appraisal (SCEIA), which appraises proposals while a State Expert Appraisal Committee is not functioning.
raw: proposal accepted and referred to sceia

mom_pending.label: Minutes of meeting pending
mom_pending.definition: The minutes of the appraisal committee's meeting are waiting to be prepared by its member secretary.
raw: pending at ms for mom creation

mom_published.label: Minutes of meeting published
mom_published.definition: The appraisal committee's minutes have been issued.

public_hearing_examination.label: Public hearing under examination
public_hearing_examination.definition: The record of the statutory public hearing is before the authority.

stage1_fc_awaited.label: Stage-I forest clearance awaited
stage1_fc_awaited.definition: The proposal waits on Stage-I forest clearance, the in-principle approval to divert forest land under the Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980, now the Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam.

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
withdrawn.definition: The applicant has withdrawn the proposal.

pulled_back.label: Pulled back by the applicant
pulled_back.definition: The register records that the applicant took the proposal back before a decision, using this wording in place of a withdrawal.

withdrawal_request_accepted.label: Withdrawal accepted
withdrawal_request_accepted.definition: The applicant asked to withdraw and the authority agreed.

pending_ms_withdraw.label: Withdrawal request pending
pending_ms_withdraw.definition: The applicant has asked to withdraw, and the authority has not yet acted on the request.
raw: pending at ms for proposal withdraw
pending at ms for proposal withdraw request

returned_in_present_form.label: Returned in its present form
returned_in_present_form.definition: The authority returned the proposal to the applicant without deciding it on its merits, so that it can be filed again.

returned_to_ua.label: Returned to the user agency
returned_to_ua.definition: The authority sent the proposal back to the user agency, the body that applied to use the land.

delisted.label: Delisted
delisted.definition: The proposal has been removed from the list of active proposals.

violation_reported.label: Violation reported
violation_reported.definition: The register records a reported violation of the environmental clearance rules against this proposal.

unrecorded.label: Not recorded
unrecorded.definition: The register carries no status for this proposal.

ms_verification_completed.label: Member secretary verification completed
ms_verification_completed.definition: The member secretary has finished verifying the application.

examination_completed.label: Examination completed
examination_completed.definition: The authority has finished examining the application.

proposal_acceptance.label: Accepted
proposal_acceptance.definition: The authority has accepted the application for processing.

eds_examination_completed.label: Essential details examination completed
eds_examination_completed.definition: The authority has finished examining the reply to its request for essential details.

ads_replied.label: Additional details supplied
ads_replied.definition: The applicant has answered the authority's request for additional details.

processed_by_ms_seiaa.label: Processed by the member secretary, SEIAA
processed_by_ms_seiaa.definition: Acted on by the member secretary of the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority and passed onward.

processed_by_ms_seac.label: Processed by the member secretary, SEAC
processed_by_ms_seac.definition: Acted on by the member secretary of the State Expert Appraisal Committee and passed onward.

forwarded_to_spcb.label: Forwarded to the pollution control board
forwarded_to_spcb.definition: The member secretary has sent the proposal to the State Pollution Control Board or Pollution Control Committee for its comments and fee demand.
raw: forwarded to ms spcb/pcc by ms

comments_furnished.label: Pollution control board comments furnished
comments_furnished.definition: The State Pollution Control Board or Pollution Control Committee has given its comments on the proposal.

comments_late.label: Pollution control board comments not furnished in time
comments_late.definition: The board did not give its comments within the period allowed.

demand_note_raised.label: Fee demand raised
demand_note_raised.definition: The board has raised a demand for the processing fee.
raw: demand note raised by ms spcb/pcc to pp

demand_note_late.label: Fee demand not raised in time
demand_note_late.definition: The board did not raise its fee demand within the period allowed.
raw: demand note not raised on time

payment_furnished.label: Payment details furnished
payment_furnished.definition: The applicant has supplied evidence of payment of the fee.
raw: payment details furnished by pp to ms spcb/pcc

payment_approved.label: Payment approved
payment_approved.definition: The board has accepted the applicant's payment.

payment_rejected.label: Payment rejected
payment_rejected.definition: The board has refused the applicant's payment.

transferred_to_state.label: Transferred to the state
transferred_to_state.definition: Moved from central to state appraisal.

transferred_to_ministry.label: Transferred to the ministry
transferred_to_ministry.definition: Moved from state to central appraisal.

transferred_to_sceia.label: Transferred to SCEIA
transferred_to_sceia.definition: Moved to the Standing Committee on Environment Impact Appraisal (SCEIA) because the term of the State appraisal committee or authority had expired.
raw: transferred to sceia due to seac/seiaa expiry

transferred_from_sceia.label: Transferred back from SCEIA
transferred_from_sceia.definition: Returned from SCEIA after the State appraisal committee was reconstituted.
raw: transferred from sceia to seac after reconstitution of seac/seiaa

parked.label: Parked by the authority
parked.definition: Set aside by the authority without a decision.

recalled.label: Recalled
recalled.definition: The authority has called the proposal back from the stage it had reached.

reopen_requested.label: Reopening requested
reopen_requested.definition: The applicant has asked for the proposal to be reopened.

reopened.label: Reopened for reconsideration
reopened.definition: The authority has reopened the proposal to consider it again.

delisted_by_system.label: Delisted automatically
delisted_by_system.definition: The portal removed the proposal automatically when a time limit lapsed, without any decision by the authority. Such a proposal can later be restored.

processed_by_ms.label: Processed by the member secretary
processed_by_ms.definition: The member secretary has acted on the proposal and passed it on; the register does not name the authority.

processed_by_ms_sceia.label: Processed by the member secretary, SCEIA
processed_by_ms_sceia.definition: The member secretary of the Standing Committee on Environment Impact Appraisal (SCEIA) has acted on the proposal and passed it on.

processed_by_ms_saeia.label: Processed by the member secretary, SAEIA
processed_by_ms_saeia.definition: The member secretary of the Standing Authority on Environment Impact Assessment (SAEIA) has acted on the proposal and passed it on.

transferred_from_saeia.label: Transferred from SAEIA to SEIAA
transferred_from_saeia.definition: Returned from the Standing Authority on Environment Impact Assessment (SAEIA) to the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority after the appraisal committee was reconstituted.
raw: transferred from saeia to seiaa after reconstitution of seac/seiaa

transferred_to_saeia.label: Transferred to SAEIA
transferred_to_saeia.definition: Moved to the Standing Authority on Environment Impact Assessment (SAEIA) because the term of the State appraisal committee or authority had expired.
raw: transferred to saeia due to seac/seiaa expiry

stage1_fc_uploaded.label: Stage-I forest clearance uploaded
stage1_fc_uploaded.definition: The Stage-I forest clearance, the in-principle approval to divert forest land, has been uploaded to the proposal's record.

pending_ms_seac.label: Pending with the member secretary, SEAC
pending_ms_seac.definition: Awaiting action by the member secretary of the State Expert Appraisal Committee.

pending_seiaa.label: Pending with SEIAA
pending_seiaa.definition: Awaiting action by the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority.

unclassified.label: Not classified
unclassified.definition: The register has begun using a status we have not yet defined. It is shown in the register's own words and counted on its own.
